title: 真实Helm跨域Chart下载：仓库认证保留，制品来源不继承仓库凭据
body:
## 操作任务
实现fetch(run,case)，先用Helm3 repo add teaching-repo case.repo并传--username case.user --password case.credential，随后pull teaching-repo/case.chart --version 0.1.0 --destination case.destination，两次非0均抛RuntimeError。不添加--pass-credentials，不把凭据直接传给pull，不走pull --repo快捷路径；现有3.18.6实测该快捷路径即便未加pass-credentials也会向index指向的异源包发送认证，不可只凭参数缺席断言安全。不得为匿名制品下载去掉仓库认证。平台两台私有HTTP服务：index与同源包需要随机教学Basic凭据，index另指向localhost的异源公开包。实际下载两包且核对字节，异源不能出现Authorization，同源仍需认证，不改case/默认Helm配置、不安装release。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实现有Helm3.18.6命名仓库下载路径及HTTP getter、已认证index与异源/同源Chart请求；只有随机私有教学凭据，禁止外部地址。无HTTPS重定向、TLS信任、OCI及所有HTTP客户端行为证明；不安装Chart/构建镜像/改真实认证默认值。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释Helm特有处理机制与边界
列出制品或对象层面的可核对证据
覆盖依赖失败及不可逆副作用

conversion.original_title: 【Helm 3】Chart仓库跨域下载时，如何验收pass-credentials不会把认证信息发给非预期主机？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server,io,tarfile,base64,secrets,json,hashlib,copy,yaml
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def archive(name):
 stream=io.BytesIO()
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=stream,mode='w:gz') as package:
  raw=('apiVersion: v2\nname: '+name+'\nversion: 0.1.0\n').encode();info=tarfile.TarInfo(name+'/Chart.yaml');info.size=len(raw);info.mode=0o600;package.addfile(info,io.BytesIO(raw))
 return stream.getvalue()
packages={name:archive(name) for name in ('localchart','remotechart')};seen=[]
user='teaching';credential=secrets.token_hex(12);expected='Basic '+base64.b64encode((user+':'+credential).encode()).decode()
class Artifact(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  # Store only whether authentication arrived, never the actual header value.
  seen.append(('artifact',self.path,self.headers.get('Authorization') is not None))
  body=packages['remotechart'];self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
artifact=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Artifact)
class Repository(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  approved=self.headers.get('Authorization')==expected;seen.append(('repository',self.path,approved))
  if not approved:self.send_response(403);self.end_headers();return
  if self.path=='/index.yaml':
   index=dict(apiVersion='v1',entries={name:[dict(apiVersion='v2',name=name,version='0.1.0',urls=[('http://localhost:'+str(artifact.server_port)+'/remotechart-0.1.0.tgz') if name=='remotechart' else ('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.server.server_port)+'/localchart-0.1.0.tgz')],digest=hashlib.sha256(packages[name]).hexdigest())] for name in packages})
   body=yaml.safe_dump(index).encode()
  elif self.path=='/localchart-0.1.0.tgz':body=packages['localchart']
  else:self.send_response(404);self.end_headers();return
  self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
repository=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Repository)
threads=[threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True) for server in (artifact,repository)]
for thread in threads:thread.start()
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-helm-origin-') as directory:
  root=pathlib.Path(directory);env={**os.environ,'HELM_CACHE_HOME':str(root/'cache'),'HELM_CONFIG_HOME':str(root/'config'),'HELM_DATA_HOME':str(root/'data'),'NO_PROXY':'localhost,127.0.0.1'}
  def run(args):
   result=subprocess.run(['helm',*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8);return result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr
  repo='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(repository.server_port)
  # Establish the risky flag's actual behavior before calling student code.
  risky=root/'risky';risky.mkdir();code,out,err=run(['pull','remotechart','--repo',repo,'--version','0.1.0','--username',user,'--password',credential,'--pass-credentials','--destination',str(risky)])
  assert code==0 and any(where=='artifact' and auth for where,path,auth in seen),'fixture did not demonstrate cross-origin credential forwarding'
  assert (risky/'remotechart-0.1.0.tgz').read_bytes()==packages['remotechart']
  seen.clear();default=os.environ.get('HELM_CONFIG_HOME');original_packages=copy.deepcopy(packages)
  print('NATIVE_HELM_PASS_CREDENTIALS_ACTUALLY_FORWARDED_TEACHING_AUTH_TO_OTHER_HOST',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:authenticate_repository_without_cross_origin_forwarding',flush=True)
  for chart in ('remotechart','localchart'):
   destination=root/chart;destination.mkdir();case=dict(chart=chart,repo=repo,user=user,credential=credential,destination=str(destination));original=copy.deepcopy(case)
   try:task.fetch(run,case)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student repository-scoped authentication failed') from error
   assert case==original and (destination/(chart+'-0.1.0.tgz')).read_bytes()==packages[chart]
  assert any(where=='artifact' and not auth for where,path,auth in seen),'cross-origin artifact did not receive an anonymous download'
  assert not any(where=='artifact' and auth for where,path,auth in seen),'repository credential crossed unapproved origin'
  assert any(where=='repository' and path=='/localchart-0.1.0.tgz' and auth for where,path,auth in seen),'same-origin authentication was incorrectly stripped'
  assert all(auth for where,path,auth in seen if where=='repository')
  assert packages==original_packages and os.environ.get('HELM_CONFIG_HOME')==default
  print('NATIVE_HELM_INDEX_AND_SAME_ORIGIN_AUTH_KEPT_CROSS_ORIGIN_ARTIFACT_ANONYMOUS',flush=True)
finally:
 for server in (artifact,repository):server.shutdown();server.server_close()
 for thread in threads:thread.join(2);assert not thread.is_alive()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
